name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbent Keith Self running with fundraising edge
model.rationale: TX-03's R+11 lean, Self's incumbency and fundraising advantage, and markets pricing Democratic odds around 4% all point to a comfortable Republican hold, with no polling or ratings evidence suggesting otherwise.
model.watch: A late surge in Democratic spending or polling showing Hunt within single digits would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Keith Self seeks a third term in this Collin County-area seat, which leans Republican by about 11 points. He was renominated without difficulty and has out-raised Democrat Evan Hunt, with modest outside support on his side and none opposing him. Hunt has raised a credible but modest sum and enters the final stretch with limited cash on hand.

No public general-election polling covers the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive. Prediction markets give Self roughly a 94% chance of winning. The fundamentals point to a Republican margin in the low-to-mid teens, consistent with the district's recent history, though a strong national Democratic environment could narrow it somewhat.
